description: This file defines the OnHeapColumnVector class, a core component in Apache Spark's SQL execution engine for in-memory columnar data storage. It manages various data types, nullability, and memory allocation for vectorized processing.

classes.name: OnHeapColumnVector
classes.description: A vectorized column class for in-memory JVM array storage, supporting multiple data types and null handling, used in Spark SQL's execution engine.

methods.name: allocateColumns
methods.description: Allocates an array of OnHeapColumnVector instances for each field in a schema or fields array, with specified capacity.

methods.name: reserveNewColumn
methods.description: Creates a new OnHeapColumnVector with specified capacity and data type.
